context: TV news desk: Sakura and Ren discuss a minister's policy announcement.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: news-analysis register; civic/institutional vocabulary in its natural home.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 今日、大臣が新しい政策を発表しました。
lines.en: Today the minister announced a new policy.
lines.style: crisp adult anchor voice, soft warm professional clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 田中氏の説明は、とても具体的でしたね。
lines.en: Mr. Tanaka's explanation was very concrete.
lines.style: measured young commentator voice, soft warm analytical calm throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: この政策は、行政の負担を減らすそうです。
lines.en: This policy reportedly reduces the administrative burden.
lines.style: clear adult anchor voice, soft warm professional clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 委員会でも、長く議論されてきた問題です。
lines.en: It's an issue the committee long debated.
lines.style: thoughtful young commentator voice, soft warm analytical calm throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 反対する委員も、いたと聞いています。
lines.en: I hear some committee members opposed it.
lines.style: probing adult anchor voice, soft warm professional clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ええ、氏の答弁は慎重でした。
lines.style: careful young commentator voice, soft warm analytical calm throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 行政の現場は、どう受け止めるでしょう。
lines.en: How will the administrative front lines react?
lines.style: curious adult anchor voice, soft warm professional clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 実際の効果は、これから見えてきます。
lines.en: The real effects will become clear from here.
lines.style: measured young commentator voice, soft warm analytical calm throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 大臣は、来月も会見を開くそうです。
lines.en: The minister will reportedly hold another briefing next month.
lines.style: crisp adult anchor voice, soft warm professional clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: その政策の続報を、待ちたいですね。
lines.en: We'll await further news on that policy.
lines.style: calm young commentator voice, soft warm analytical reflective throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 視聴者の皆さん、また明日お伝えします。
lines.style: warm adult anchor voice, soft warm professional closing throughout
